LESSON: ENGAGING PARENTS OR

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Care for the 3.3.2Communicating messages By the end of the sub-strand, the  Lea
Topic 3.3.3: Engaging parents or

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Engaging parents or. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Engaging parents or
2. Practise Engaging parents or at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Engaging parents or

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Engaging parents or
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Engaging parents or. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Engaging parents or at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Engaging parents or at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Engaging parents or
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Engaging parents or. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Engaging parents or using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Engaging parents or in the examples.
2. Explain Engaging parents or to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Engaging parents or.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Engaging parents or using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Engaging parents or important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss with parents management on various ways of managing b) involve parents or guardians waste and report back in waste management
2. Show case ways of c) appreciate the participation managing waste to parents or of parents or guardians in guardians during school events waste management

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Engaging parents or
2. Practise Engaging parents or at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Engaging parents or

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
